IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(50000,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [FusionTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [TextPath] AS ([utility].[GetBreadcrumbStringWrapper]('FusionAttributeType',[ID],'.')), [Assignable] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAttributeType_Assignable] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [ScanEnabled] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAttributeType_ScanEnabled] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionAttributeType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttributeType_Parent') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeType_Parent] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeType_Parent] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FusionAttributeType_FusionTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FusionAttributeType_FusionTypeID] ON [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] ( [FusionTypeID] ASC ) END

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON delete AssetType where Object = 'FusionAttributeType' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; insert into AssetType (Name, Description, Class, DisplayFormat, [State], [Hierarchical], [HierarchyMaximumDepth], [Object], [ObjectID], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy]) select Name, null, 4, '{Name}', 1, 0, 1, 'FusionAttributeType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy, coalesce(UpdatedOn, getutcdate()), UpdatedBy from inserted END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FusionAttributeType_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; update T set T.Name = S.Name, T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from AssetType T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' and T.ObjectID = S.ID END
